dedupe_keys.name: muse rasa geospatial energy consumer agent datasets

description: The MUSE-RASA research team publishes geospatial inputs describing heterogeneous residential energy consumers in 28 global modelling regions. The Figshare collection includes agent attributes, regional boundaries, heat-use classes, GDP and population evolution, retrofit-preference surveys from China and Ecuador, and validation tables. Six household energy services are represented across eight scenarios. CSV tables and shapefiles are provided, some in RAR archives. Baseline consumer diversity refers to 2010, while demographic and economic trajectories extend to 2100. All inspected deposits are free under CC0. These files support agent-based energy-demand and technology-adoption simulations using model-muse-os. A caveat is that regional assumptions and survey evidence may not transfer directly to another population. The deposited data do not include the separately restricted RASA generation code. No archive contents were downloaded or model interfaces tested.
